knowledge:
- key_parameters: references=Vector of filenames of the reference sequence in FASTA format ;; outdir=Output directory for the generated index files ;; prefix=Prefix for the generated index files ;; sequences=Filename of the file containing short reads to be aligned ;; index=Index filename prefix (minus trailing .X.ebwt) ;; outfile=Output file path for the generated alignments (typically SAM) ;; sam=Logical; if TRUE, writes hits in SAM format ;; best=Logical; if TRUE, guarantees hits are in the best stratum ;; cfg=A named list specifying SpliceMap parameters (e.g., genome_dir, reads_list1, read_format, quality_format, outfile, temp_path, bowtie_base_dir)
- alternatives: QuasR=The documentation strongly recommends using the QuasR package instead of Rbowtie directly, as QuasR provides a simpler interface and covers the entire analysis workflow (pre-processing, alignment, and quantification).
- when_to_use: Use when aligning short DNA or RNA-seq reads to a reference genome, or when performing de novo splice junction discovery and alignment for reads that are at least 50bp long.
- pitfalls: SpliceMap can only be used for reads that are at least 50bp long ;; bowtie only generates ungapped alignments, so SpliceMap must be used if spliced alignments are required.

workflows.name: ungapped_alignment_bowtie
workflows.intent: Build a reference genome index and align short reads to generate ungapped alignments in SAM format.
workflows.stages: 1. Build reference index using bowtie_build ;; 2. Align short reads to the index using bowtie
workflows.code:
refFiles <- dir(system.file(package="Rbowtie", "samples", "refs"), full=TRUE)
indexDir <- file.path(tempdir(), "refsIndex")
tmp <- bowtie_build(references=refFiles, outdir=indexDir, prefix="index", force=TRUE)
readsFiles <- system.file(package="Rbowtie", "samples", "reads", "reads.fastq")
samFiles <- file.path(tempdir(), "alignments.sam")
bowtie(sequences=readsFiles, index=file.path(indexDir, "index"), outfile=samFiles, sam=TRUE, best=TRUE, force=TRUE)

workflows.name: spliced_alignment_splicemap
workflows.intent: Perform de novo splice junction discovery and alignment for reads >= 50bp.
workflows.stages: 1. Define configuration parameters in a named list ;; 2. Run spliced alignment using SpliceMap
workflows.code:
readsFiles <- system.file(package="Rbowtie", "samples", "reads", "reads.fastq")
refDir <- system.file(package="Rbowtie", "samples", "refs", "chr1.fa")
indexDir <- file.path(tempdir(), "refsIndex")
samFiles <- file.path(tempdir(), "splicedAlignments.sam")
cfg <- list(genome_dir=refDir, reads_list1=readsFiles, read_format="FASTQ", quality_format="phred-33", outfile=samFiles, temp_path=tempdir(), max_intron=400000, min_intron=20000, max_multi_hit=10, seed_mismatch=1, read_mismatch=2, num_chromosome_together=2, bowtie_base_dir=file.path(indexDir, "index"), num_threads=4, try_hard="yes", selectSingleHit=TRUE)
res <- SpliceMap(cfg)
